abhiniggaṇhanta.p: [Abhi+ni+gaha+ṇhā+anta] (ti) CL=9 To overwhelm.To oppress. A person who overwhelms ,vanquishes ,oppresses  See also Abhiniggaṇhitabba

abhiniggaṇhāti.p: [Abhi+ni+gaha+ṇhā+ti] (kri) CL=9 (A) Hold firmly. To hold and -squeeze-press-strangle the limbs big and small .(b) overwhelm and vanquish.  See also Abhiniggaṇhitabba-
a: အဘိနိဂ္ဂဏှာတိ(ကြိ)

B:
abhiniggaṇhāti：abhiniggaṇhāti（kri）
အဘိနိဂ္ဂဏှာတိ（ကြိ）
[abhi+ni+gaha+ṇhā+ti]
[အဘိ+နိ+ဂဟ+ဏှာ+တိ]
P: Abhiniggaṇhāti，[abhi + niggaṇhāti] to hold back，restrain，prevent，prohibit； always in combn. with abhinippīḷeti M.I，120； A.V，230. -- Cp. abhiniggaṇhanā. （Page 65）
K:
abhiniggaṇhāti：＂အဘိနိဂ္ဂဏှာတိ（ကြိ）
[အဘိ+နိ+ဂဟ+ဏှာ+တိ]
（က） မြဲမြံစွာကိုင်၏၊ အင်္ဂါကြီးငယ်ကို ကိုင်၍-ဖိ-ညှပ်-ဖျစ်-ညှစ်-၏။ （ခ） လွှမ်းမိုးနှိပ်နင်း၏။ အဘိနိဂ္ဂဏှိတဗ္ဗ-လည်းကြည့်။
R:
abhiniggaṇhāti：အဘိ-နိဂ္ဂဏှာတိ （အဘိ+နိ√ဂဟ်）
အလွန် နှိပ်၏။
DOP: abhiniggaṇhāti pr. 3 sg. [ BHS abhinigṛhṇati], takes hold of; holds fast, restrains ; Vin III 121, 29 (bhikkhu … itthiyā kāyena kāyaṃ āmasati … ~āti abhinippīḷeti gaṇhāti chupati); M I 121, 7 (balavā puriso dubbalataraṃ purisaṃ … ~eyya abhinippīḷeyya abhisantāpeyya); A V 230, 13 (ekacco adhammikena vādena adhammikaṃ vādaṃ ~āti abhinippīḷeti); — part.pr. abhiniggaṇha(t), mfn. , M I 121, 2 (cetasā cittaṃ ~ato abhinippīḷayato abhisantāpayato); — absol. abhiniggaṇhitvā, Spk I 36, 14 (cetasā cittaṃ ~itvā); — fpp abhiniggaṇhitabba, mfn. , M I 120, 37 (cetasā cittaṃ ~itabbaṃ abhinippīḷetabbaṃ abhisantāpetabbaṃ).
CPD: abhi-niggaṇhāti , pr. 3 sg. [ sa. *abhi + ni + √grah], [ often [ with 'reciprocal cpd.s' as kāyena(-) kāyaṃ, etc. ]; ( a ) to take hold of, to hold fast; Vin lll 121, 29 foll . (itthiyā kāyena kāyaṃ āmasati . . . ~āti abhinippīḷeti); — ( b ) to keep down, restrain; AN V 230, 13 foll . (adhammikena vādena adhammikaṃ vādaṃ ~āti abhinippīḷeti); 1 sg ~āmi (cetasā cittaṃ), MN l abhi-niggaṇhāti 93, 24 S e 212, 6 ); part. m. gen. ~gaṇhato (cetasā eit- taṃ), MN l 121, 2-14 = 242, 29-35 ; pot. 3 sg. ~eyya ( a; dubbalataraṃ purisaṃ sīse vā gahetvā khandhe vā gahetvā), MN l 121, 1 = 242, 32 ; 1 sg. ~eyyaṃ (cetasā cittaṃ), MN l 242, 25 (= niggaṇheyyaṃ, Ps; cf . Sn 716); grd. ~itabba, n. ~aṃ (cetasā cit- taṃ), MN l 120, 37 .
NCP: pr. 3 sg. | abhinigga.nhaati takes hold of; holds fast, restraints.
